name: Blot Immobilier
verdict: Rennes real-estate group dating from 1968, led by members of the Blot family according to the company register; official sponsor of Stade Rennais since 2010. Nothing found.
note: Company register: David Blot président, Sandra Blot vice-présidente, a conseil de surveillance of three Blot family members and Didier Ferre. No state or state fund appears in the sources.
